scope: Memory management in LLM agents for software development
queries: (all:"software engineering" OR all:"coding agent") AND (all:memory OR all:"context management")
(all:"SWE-bench" OR all:"code agent") AND (all:memory OR all:"experience reuse" OR all:"skill bank")
(all:"software engineering" OR all:"coding agents") AND (all:"reflection" OR all:"persistent notes" OR all:"context compression")
inclusion: Explicit software-development agent setting or software-engineering evaluation
Memory representation, lifecycle, retrieval, compression, reuse, or evaluation is a substantive contribution
Primary publication source available for verification
Initial submission at or before the collection cutoff
exclusion: Generic agent memory without an explicit software-development connection
Medical/clinical coding, which does not mean software development
Ordinary code retrieval without an explicit memory contribution
Product marketing or implementation repository without a research paper
Duplicate versions; retain one canonical record and alternate source links

sources.name: arXiv
sources.role: Primary metadata and abstracts; official Atom API first, rate-limited abstract-page fallback

sources.name: Google Research / OpenReview
sources.role: Author's primary research announcement verifies ReasoningBank conference status; OpenReview link retained, direct API requires challenge verification

similarity.text: summary, memory representation, lifecycle descriptions, workflow stages
similarity.grouping: Deterministic average-linkage agglomerative clustering at cosine similarity 0.64, alongside overlapping source-based mechanism labels; automatic groups require human review

review: Agent-assisted extraction checked against primary-source abstracts; independent human review pending. Full-text evidence used only when explicitly recorded.
coverage: A focused initial collection, not a systematic or exhaustive review. Search coverage and counts are reported in the collection manifest.
